title: Resume coordination without treating activity as delivery
preconditions: A work item can receive workspace assignments and concurrent progress events.

steps.action: Assign the work item to a branch using its portable workspace identity.
steps.expected_result: The assignment persists the responsible branch and parent work-item identity.

steps.action: Record concurrent progress heads and reload the work plan.
steps.expected_result: Every head remains visible until explicitly reconciled.

steps.action: Evaluate the work item without a completion, contract, or merge release fact.
steps.expected_result: Assignment and progress remain coordination facts and do not mark the criterion delivered.

expected_result: Pass when assignment and progress survive reload and remain distinct from delivery proof; fail if a concurrent head disappears or activity releases dependent work.
